name: Beadline the Silver-Spotted Cat
blurb: Beadline, a pale silver shorthair with a neat row of small round slate-blue spots down her back, naps on cool flagstones and hops the stones at dusk.

name: Rime the Blue-Point Cat
blurb: Rime, an ice-white cat with slate-blue ears, mask, paws and tail and bright blue eyes, sits so still on the coolest shady stone that moths land by him.

name: Flicker the Slate-Blue Cat
blurb: Flicker, a slate-blue shorthair with pale green eyes, chases the tiny dancing dot of light along the garden wall each evening and never catches it.
